Small Update:

 Added an effect when using the rope without hitting the box (rope is required).
 Added and fixed some small tutorials.

notes.title: Update Announcement: New Ranking System
notes.content:
New Ranking System

We are pleased to announce that we have added a new ranking system to our game. Players can now compete and compare scores with players worldwide. This system adds a new level of challenge and enjoyment to your gaming experience.


 Total Score Ranking Accumulate the highest score by completing levels, collecting all stars, and proving you can complete levels with the fewest moves.
 Star Ranking Show your skill by collecting more stars than other players or completing every level perfectly.


Join the challenge and prove your abilities in the new ranking system today!
